packs.name: Tidemark Island
packs.description: A quiet tropical island with open beaches, layered jungle, a thatched shelter and moving wildlife, built in Holodeck around the Cove.

packs.name: Courtyard
packs.description: A walled limestone plaza beside the Cove, with a tiered fountain, three statues, planted beds, benches and lanterns.

packs.name: Cove
packs.description: Holodeck’s starter Cove after its quality pass: a sheltered platform with a linen canopy, cushions, a hearth table, fern planters, a rug, a lamp and a mood board.

packs.name: Crescent Cove
packs.description: A crescent of palm-lined beach around a turquoise lagoon, with seagrass meadows, coral heads, a jetty and a rocky headland, built in Holodeck around the Cove.
